name: Nexora Lab
shortDescription: A self-hosted infrastructure dashboard connecting host telemetry, topology and administration. Open-source release-candidate work.
description: Nexora Lab is a self-hosted infrastructure dashboard for inspecting Linux hosts, Proxmox guests and Docker workloads. Telemetry, history and topology connect resource readings with the systems they describe.
problemSolution: A host list does not explain how virtual machines, containers and physical resources relate. The project addresses that visibility gap: it connects changing metrics with the systems they describe, so an administrator can inspect a host in context.

name: Nexora Agent
shortDescription: A plugin-based Linux telemetry agent reporting host, container, sensor and disk information to Nexora Lab.
description: Nexora Agent is a plugin-based Linux telemetry agent that reports host, container, sensor and disk information to Nexora Lab. It collects local details that a virtualization API cannot always provide.
problemSolution: A virtualization API cannot expose every local temperature sensor, service state or disk-health reading. The Agent fills those gaps while allowing unsupported collectors to remain unavailable without disabling the whole application.

name: CompressMe
shortDescription: A Python batch image compression tool with a PySide6 desktop interface, CLI and duplicate detection.
description: CompressMe is a Python image compression tool for processing folders, reviewing duplicates and exporting reports. A PySide6 desktop application and command-line interface share the same batch-processing engine.
problemSolution: Processing an image folder one file at a time makes it difficult to keep settings consistent or see which files failed. A repeatable batch workflow also needs to distinguish identical files from visually similar images.
imageAlt: CompressMe desktop dashboard showing a compression queue and processing reports

name: Jenica Salazar's Portfolio
shortDescription: A client Next.js portfolio presenting Jenica Salazar’s professional experience and MovieFlix founder story.
description: Jenica Salazar’s client portfolio website brings her professional background, experience and MovieFlix founder story into a responsive Next.js presentation.
problemSolution: A résumé, certificates and a separate project story can be difficult to assess when presented independently. The website gives those materials a clear sequence while keeping résumé and contact access easy to find.
imageAlt: Jenica Salazar's portfolio homepage with her portrait and professional introduction

name: MovieFlix
shortDescription: A privately deployed, self-hosted media streaming platform with library browsing and FFmpeg processing.
description: MovieFlix is a self-hosted media streaming platform for organizing a local video collection and serving playback. Its library interface connects media scanning, title information and FFmpeg processing; this case study keeps the private deployment address confidential.
problemSolution: Media files need more than a directory listing: people need recognizable titles, artwork and playback that can seek through large files. Different codecs add another compatibility challenge.
imageAlt: MovieFlix library homepage showing featured artwork and media rows

name: Donut House
shortDescription: A fictional Next.js bakery storefront with product customization, a shopping cart and simulated checkout.
description: Donut House is an interactive bakery storefront demonstration built with Next.js. Visitors can browse products, customize choices and follow a simulated cart and checkout journey.
problemSolution: A custom box is more complicated than a single product purchase: choices need to remain understandable as items, quantities and options change. The design challenge is to carry those decisions from discovery into the cart without losing context.
disclaimer: Portfolio Commerce Concept — No real orders or payments
imageAlt: Donut House storefront showing donut collections and custom box presentation

name: Mark Jaron's Portfolio
shortDescription: A client portfolio for industrial engineer Mark Jaron, presenting experience, studies, certifications and a practical toolkit.
description: Mark Jaron’s client portfolio website presents his industrial engineering experience, studies, certifications and practical toolkit in a structured professional profile.
problemSolution: A long professional record needs clear grouping so visitors can understand responsibilities and inspect relevant work. The site turns that material into a readable professional narrative rather than copying a résumé into one uninterrupted block.
imageAlt: Mark Jaron's portfolio introduction and engineering experience presentation

name: Your Coffee
shortDescription: A fictional café ordering website with searchable drinks, customization and a browser-persisted demonstration cart.
description: Your Coffee is a café ordering website demo with a searchable drink menu, customization options and a JavaScript shopping cart. The ordering journey demonstrates interface behavior without accepting real orders.
problemSolution: A broad drink menu becomes harder to explore when customers also need to choose options. The interface brings discovery and customization together, while keeping the current order visible.
disclaimer: Portfolio Café Concept — No real orders or payments
imageAlt: Your Coffee café homepage showing the drink menu and ordering presentation

name: Python-Keybr
shortDescription: A Python terminal typing trainer with a curses interface, adaptive practice and local session feedback.
description: Python-Keybr is a Python terminal typing trainer inspired by keybr.com. Its curses interface provides practice, timing feedback and keyboard diagnostics without a browser.
problemSolution: A terminal practice tool needs to show errors and progress without interrupting typing. The project also explores adaptive practice, where weaker letters receive attention and new letters unlock as confidence improves.

name: DistroZSH
shortDescription: A lightweight Linux ZSH configuration with a distribution-aware prompt and selectable layouts, without a shell framework.
description: DistroZSH is a lightweight Linux ZSH configuration with a distribution-aware prompt and selectable layouts. It provides a consistent shell setup without a shell framework or plugin manager.
problemSolution: Shell customization can accumulate dependencies and changes that are difficult to undo. This project provides a defined configuration while adapting the prompt's appearance to the running distribution.

name: Starbucks Login
shortDescription: An unofficial responsive login-interface demo with frontend validation. It does not connect to Starbucks accounts.
description: Starbucks Login is an unofficial responsive login-interface demo built for frontend practice. Validation and feedback run in the browser; the page does not authenticate users against Starbucks services.
problemSolution: A login interface needs understandable fields and clear feedback when input is incomplete or incorrect. This small project focuses on that interaction rather than account management.
imageAlt: Unofficial Starbucks-inspired login form with email and password fields

name: Smart Expense Visualizer
shortDescription: A browser-local expense tracking dashboard demo with editable records and Chart.js category charts.
description: Smart Expense Visualizer is a browser-based expense tracking dashboard demonstration. JavaScript records and category charts help inspect a local collection of entries without a server account.
problemSolution: A transaction list alone makes spending patterns hard to inspect. The dashboard connects each entry to category totals, summary cards and a chart that changes with the records.
disclaimer: Live Demo — Data stays in your browser
imageAlt: Expense dashboard showing summary cards, a category chart and transaction table

name: Monthsary
shortDescription: A personal interactive anniversary website with a shared-moment timeline, photographs and letters.
description: Monthsary is an interactive personal anniversary website that brings photographs, letters and shared moments into a timeline and media galleries.
problemSolution: Personal memories deserve a coherent presentation rather than a disconnected set of files. The design challenge is to make the story easy to explore while keeping its intimate purpose intact.
imageAlt: Monthsary anniversary website with a personal timeline and photo presentation

name: JohnVex-WinOps
shortDescription: A PowerShell Windows administration toolkit with allowlisted operations, dry-run planning, verification and structured logs.
description: JohnVex-WinOps is a PowerShell Windows administration toolkit that organizes diagnostics and system operations behind a modular engine. Commands follow defined checks and execution boundaries.
problemSolution: Ad-hoc maintenance scripts can make it difficult to understand what will change, what privileges are needed and what happened afterward. The toolkit gives those operations a defined planning and logging workflow.
imageAlt: JohnVex-WinOps administration interface showing diagnostic and operation options

name: J&GLO
shortDescription: A fictional Next.js fashion storefront with product variants, a shopping bag and a browser-persisted wishlist.
description: J&GLO is a fictional Next.js fashion storefront with product variants, collection pages and an interactive shopping bag. Its editorial presentation supports browsing and simulated shopping rather than live commerce.
problemSolution: Campaign imagery and a usable catalog have different jobs. The design challenge is to preserve the fashion identity while making variants, sizes and the current shopping bag understandable.
disclaimer: Portfolio store concept — no real orders or payments.
imageAlt: J&GLO fictional fashion storefront with campaign imagery and garment collections

name: ARKOSENYO
shortDescription: A client architecture website demonstration with project records, search, filters and image galleries.
description: ARKOSENYO is a client architecture website development project presenting services, project records and image galleries. The published demonstration includes search and filtering for exploring the work.
problemSolution: An architecture website needs to connect project discovery with services and a clear inquiry path. I organized the client’s project material so visitors can filter work, open its details and explore imagery without losing context.
disclaimer: Client website project — published demonstration; inquiry delivery and a separate production launch are not asserted.
imageAlt: ARKOSENYO redesign concept presenting architecture imagery and project discovery

name: TAITECH Marine
shortDescription: A client marine-equipment website redesign demo with catalog search, service galleries and request previews.
description: TAITECH Marine is a client marine-equipment business website redesign project. Its published demonstration combines equipment and service presentation with search, galleries and a structured request preview.
problemSolution: Equipment and service inquiries need useful context. I connected category browsing with a request flow that asks relevant questions and lets visitors review their details before the demonstration confirmation.
disclaimer: Client website redesign — request preview only; no submission, scheduling or reserved availability is claimed.
imageAlt: TAITECH Marine redesign demonstration showing equipment and technical service presentation

name: Shoes on the Go
shortDescription: An interactive 3D footwear showcase with a directed story, model rotation, variants and touch-accessible inspection.
description: Shoes on the Go is an interactive 3D product showcase built with Three.js and React Three Fiber. A directed footwear story leads into rotation, variants and inspection controls.
problemSolution: A product presentation needs to show form and detail while still letting visitors explore it themselves. The project tests how cinematic scrolling and direct manipulation can share one model.
disclaimer: Independent, noncommercial concept — no brand affiliation or product sales.
imageAlt: Shoes on the Go 3D footwear presentation with model inspection controls

name: ARCHÉON
shortDescription: An interactive 3D architecture visualization with reversible construction stages, floor exploration and concept plans.
description: ARCHÉON is an interactive 3D architecture visualization of an original tropical-modern house concept. Visitors can move through reversible construction stages and explore concept floor plans.
problemSolution: A finished rendering hides the relationship between structure, spaces and finishes. The concept helps visitors explore those relationships through staged assembly, viewpoints and room information.
disclaimer: Architecture visualization demo — Amihan House is an illustrative concept, not a completed commission. Project briefs are downloaded locally; no requests are sent.
imageAlt: ARCHÉON Amihan House concept showing a construction stage and exploration controls
